text:
Linh: FYI ran a long soak in ap-southeast-1 last night. spot reclaim wave hit one AZ and we saw attach/detach churn + a ~18% drop in effective GPUs for the jobset.

Omar: saw it too. autoscaler logs show repeated attach failures for the same instance family, then fallback to higher-cost types. seems like we overscaled then oscillated.

Sarah: can we try a surge-smoothing policy that hedges within the AZ first? cross-AZ assignments spike kv-cache-miss-rate and P95.

Kai: rough POC policy (pseudoyaml):
```
autoscaler_policy: surge_smoothing_v1
scale_out_trigger:
  metric: queue_per_gpu
  target: 0.85
  steps: [1, 2, 5]             # small-first steps to avoid overshoot
surge_window_s: 600            # keep surge window short (10m)
scale_in:
  metric: gpu_util
  threshold: 0.30
  cooldown_s: 1200              # 20m cooldown for warmup + cache settle
  min_fraction: 0.7            # never drop below 70% during surge window
attach_strategy:
  prefer_same_az_warm: true
  prefer_low_interrupt_score: true
interrupt_handling:
  interruption_moving_avg_mins: 20
  min_samples_for_demote: 6
  grace_after_reclaim_s: 300    # 5m block on scale_in after reclaim-triggered scale_up
jitter:
  cooldown_rand_s: 90          # randomize cooldown to avoid sync
```

Omar: interruption score should be a decayed counter with a 20m window and require min_samples_for_demote to avoid flipping types on a single blip.

Linh: also add a short "cache-warm" hold after scale_up where scale_downs are suppressed until allocation_ready metric shows steady attach->ready within expected latency.

Sarah: cost tradeoff reminder: warm-AZ standby increases baseline spend. propose target steady util 68% +/- 5% so we buy p95 improvements without huge steady premium.

Kai: add a drain_safety_window per AZ (e.g., 25m) and min_reserved_instances so scale-in won't fully exhaust headroom during rolling infra ops.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary policy surge_smoothing_v1 -> pool:spot-fleet-canary applied at 2026-02-12T05:12:00Z

Omar: telemetry we need: allocation_attach_ms, allocation_ready_ms, kv_cache_miss_rate, per-az_interrupt_rate_1m/5m, queue_depth_per_gpu_p95. tag allocations with autoscaler.policy=surge_smoothing_v1.

Linh: alert rules: if allocation_attach_ms_p95 > 60s for 10m OR per-az_interrupt_rate_5m > 0.03, then failover impacted tenants to dedicated-lane and pause further spot scale-outs.

Sarah: test plan: 1) single-AZ canary 5% traffic 4h, watch kv-cache-miss-rate and p95 gen. 2) If stable, ramp to 20% with ramp-checks every 2h.

Kai: small operational note: ensure node labels + placement constraints preserve GPU model affinity for cold cache reuse (same model family == fewer tensor-layout penalties).

Omar: also instrument a short-term interrupt counter on the instance selection path and surface it in the pool dashboard so SRE can quickly spot flavor regressions.

metric-alert: scale-flap-detector suppressed (1m avg) -> recovered

Linh: PR incoming with YAML and dashboards. will run canary tomorrow morning. reconvene after the 4h run and decide on rollout cadence. Thanks everyone!
